sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:117

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:117:1
items.html: Before their entry, these five Hassadim spread there through the five Sefirot, HGT NH, of that fine Partzuf: He is precise, to teach us that as soon as the Mochin of ZA go out in AVI, whole ten Sefirot go out there, namely the entire NRNHY [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida], GAR [first three] and VAK [six ends], where the GAR are called HB and the VAK are called Daat. Except that ZA does not receive them all at once, immediately, but little by little, as he goes on to explain.
